researcher_notes: Bachelor's programmes with restricted admission (NC), applicants with a German HZB. The same page's international-HZB section states the identical application window for restricted-admission bachelor's programmes, confirmed character-for-character against the same source. Checked whether uni-assist.de is a separate deadline-setting authority for TU Berlin (per this lane's brief). It is not: uni-assist's own deadlines-processing-time page states "uni-assist's deadline is the deadline set by the university" (retrieved 2026-08-21, page self-dated "Last updated: 17 August 2026"), and uni-assist's TU Berlin university-detail page (https://www.uni-assist.de/en/tools/uni-assist-universities/detail/hochschule/58/) lists no TU-Berlin-specific date at all, only "Please inform yourself at the university about its special application procedure." TU Berlin's own page corroborates this from the other direction: "Applications with international academic credentials have the same deadlines as non-international applications." Conclusion: no separate uni-assist deadline record was created for TU Berlin. Applicants with foreign credentials must still obtain the VPD from uni-assist (4-6 week processing) in time to meet TU Berlin's own deadline below; uni-assist recommends applying at least 8 weeks before that deadline.
